purpose: Integrate frozen battery and financing observations into historical monitoring without promoting unsuccessful models
base: R25 evidence matrix, unchanged rows, scores and price ranks
battery_selection: latest economic month with available_at <= snapshot; never backfill a missing latest YoY with an older known YoY; growth_available_at must also be <= snapshot
financing_selection: latest industry decision date <= snapshot; current factor only when decision date equals snapshot and original coverage gate passes; older values retained as last observation only
clock_scope: all added dimensions historical proxy; company-fact clocks do not certify battery or financing acquisition timing
changes: descriptive last-observation changes with source dates and stale flags; not stage transitions
prediction_policy: no rank, stage, probability or allocation change; no outcome columns read
next_update: manual versioned source refresh and verification, no scheduler or network
source: R60 full reviewed monthly series; source version refresh of R50, no method or ranking change
prior: R50 preserved; new current key complete_battery_historical_monitor
